_why: W5 (heroes, gear, quests, economy): code values, names and dev tools in this area that stay English on purpose. Each entry says why.

tables.EQ_NAMES: names: gear item proper names (Phil's rule: item names are never translated)
tables.GEAR_STAT_LABEL: fallback only: gearStatLabel() shows t('gear.stat_*'); the table keeps the English for keys without a translation
tables.TECH_TRACKS: fallback only: the Academy shows techText() (t('tech.*')); the names/descs here are the English fallback
tables.CURRENCY_META: fallback only: openEconomy shows t(meta[2]) (econ.*); [1] is the English fallback
tables.G2_LADDER16: code keys: the glyph quality ladder the code compares; shown through gLadderName()/g2QualName() (glyphrank.*)
tables.PROV_LADDER: code keys: quality ladder for indexOf; shown through g2QualName() (glyphrank.*)
tables.PROV_FRAG_Q: code keys: Drill fragment quality per stage (mirrors the server's English quality); shown through g2QualName()
tables.PROV_BOSS: code keys: monster ids (lower-case), looked up in MONSTER_TYPES
tables.RANK_NAMES: unused: RANK_NAMES is read nowhere (RANK_COLOR is the colour list)
tables.EQ_BASE: unused text: only [0] (id) and [1] (icon) are read; [2] is never shown
tables.EQ_TIERS: code: tier colour words; only read by recipeStr(), which no screen calls
tables.RES: names: in-game resource names (Emberite, Voidglass, Starsilver, Cinderwood)
tables.ROLE_META: unused: only roleTag() reads it and no screen calls roleTag()
tables.ROSTER_CLASSES: code keys: class ids the filters compare and save; shown through rosterClassName() (roster.class_*)
tables.HERO_ROLE_ORDER: code keys: class ids for the hero list sort order (never shown)
tables.rosterClassF: code key: the saved class filter value ('All'); shown through rosterClassName()
tables.templeClassFilter: code key: the class filter value 'All' (compared, not shown)
tables.gearSlotSel: code key: the selected equipment slot id
tables.PORTAL_META: fallback only: portal names are shown through t('portal.*') (portalName); .label stays the English key
tables.XP_POTION_LABELS: names: XP potion item names (Minor/Greater/Major/Superior), passed as {name}/{potion} into translated lines
tables.TUTORIAL_STEPS: every text is a getter through ewT('tut.*'); the literals left are hero names (Vex, Vael, Tick) and item names (Rough Gravel, Stone Glyph, Minor XP Potion)
tables.GAUNT_PERKS: names: Gauntlet perk names (desc is translated through ewT('isle.perk_*')); the Gauntlet is retired
tables.GEM_OFFERS: names: store product names (Cluster Pack, Burger Meal) - the Play Billing SKU names; desc/detail are translated getters
tables.ST2_TABS: fallback only: the tab labels are shown through t('shop.tab_*')/t('patron.title'); [1] is the English fallback
tables.DEFAULT_G: data: the default commander name stored in a new save ('Commander'), a player name
